a09_a10_a11_policy.a11_reason: no model is fitted, so Ridge alpha, split policy, permutation policy and the historical sign convention cannot drift

main_figures.purpose: Central route-specific length effect: mean edit distance vs phoneme length, FULL/WM/LTM, split by lexicality.
main_figures.main_finding: For trained real words FULL and WM are at exact ceiling and LTM shows only a very weak slope; for novel pseudowords LTM develops a large length effect while WM stays far more robust and FULL stays near ceiling.
main_figures.primary_limitation: Lexicality and training exposure are perfectly confounded in the clean set.

main_figures.purpose: Per-seed length slopes by route and the primary LTM-WM contrast.
main_figures.main_finding: LTM-WM pseudoword slope difference is positive in all four seeds (+0.183 to +0.246 edit operations per phoneme).
main_figures.primary_limitation: Trained real words are ceiling-limited under FULL and WM, so their zero slope is structural.

main_figures.purpose: Serial-position error profile by route and lexicality.
main_figures.main_finding: LTM pseudowords show a strong late-position increase; FULL and WM increase much less.
main_figures.primary_limitation: Zip-mismatch positions, no Levenshtein alignment; pooled over seeds.

main_figures.purpose: Levenshtein operation taxonomy by route, lexicality and Short/Long, on one common absolute y-scale.
main_figures.main_finding: Substitutions dominate, then deletions, then insertions; the burden is concentrated in long LTM pseudowords.
main_figures.primary_limitation: editops tie-breaking moves counts between operation types without changing total edit distance; the forced-length horizon makes terminal insertions unobservable.

main_figures.purpose: Premature end-of-sequence rate, shortfall and length slope by route.
main_figures.main_finding: 87 observed events, 82 in LTM, all on pseudowords; the rate rises with length in LTM in all four seeds.
main_figures.primary_limitation: ON_TIME_EOS and LATE_EOS are structurally unobservable; EOS_NOT_OBSERVED is ambiguous; premature EOS is on only a minority of erroneous items.

main_figures.purpose: Continuous Zipf frequency slope of edit distance for trained real words, by route.
main_figures.main_finding: LTM Zipf slope is negative in all four seeds (mean -0.0130); higher-frequency trained words have slightly fewer errors.
main_figures.primary_limitation: Rests on sparse errors; FULL and WM are ALL_ZERO_OUTCOME by ceiling.

main_figures.purpose: Adapted grouped factor importance: held-out R2 drop and MAE increase per raw factor.
main_figures.main_finding: Route and lexicality/exposure lead jointly, length is a stable third, morphology is negligible.
main_figures.primary_limitation: The route vs lexicality/exposure ordering is not resolved by these data; importance is unsigned.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Faithful Dager Figure 2A: mean edit distance by source lexicality, morphology and length, FULL route.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: Errors appear only at length 9 in the source-pseudo condition (0.0947) and from length 7 in source-real (up to 0.0199).
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: Source Real/Pseudo labels are not training exposure: 122 source-real items were never trained.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Faithful Dager Figure 2C: positional error rate by source lexicality and relative position.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: Late-position rise in both source conditions, larger for source-pseudo (0.0417 at the final position of length 9).
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: Zip-mismatch positions with no alignment; pooled across seeds; distinct estimand from F3.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Faithful Dager Figure 2B: Ridge coefficients and permutation importance for length, lexicality and morphology.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: Length leads in all four seeds; lexicality and morphology are near zero and change sign.
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: Historical signed convention; never pooled with the adapted A15 and never on a common axis.

supplementary_figures.purpose: FULL/WM zoom companion to F4, created because the frozen >10x rule fired (ratio 22.95).
supplementary_figures.main_finding: FULL and WM operation counts resolved on their own scale.
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: Companion only; it never replaces the common-scale F4.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Faithful Dager Figure 8A: error types across the twelve original WFE conditions, FULL route.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: Only four of twelve conditions are non-zero, all of them long.
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: Source labels are not exposure; Figures 8B/8C concern ablated SWP models and are out of scope.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Adapted morphology x phoneme length by route.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: No robust morphology contrast; every interval spans zero.
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: Trained real words are at ceiling under FULL and WM.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Faithful morphology x length x source lexicality, FULL route.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: Stimulus-level replication; no robust morphology effect.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Adapted route-specific factor importance, one panel per route.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: Only LTM is estimable: lexicality/exposure > length > morphology in all four seeds.
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: FULL and WM are ceiling and sparse-error limited and are labelled, never given an artificial zero.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Held-out drop-block utility of the five predeclared interaction blocks.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: route x lexicality is the clearest stable block; the two length blocks are classified conservatively.
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: R2 and MAE disagree for route x length and lexicality x length.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Frequency slopes for lexical confidence and the gate, trained real words.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: Both slopes are positive across seeds.
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: The gate is a deterministic monotonic transform of confidence: these are linked outcomes, not independent evidence.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Gate and lexical confidence by clean lexicality.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: Confidence and gate are higher for trained real words than for novel pseudowords.
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: The gate is a FULL-route quantity only; it is not a probability that the stimulus is a word.

supplementary_figures.purpose: Gate and lexical confidence across the six training-exposure categories.
supplementary_figures.main_finding: Untrained real words pattern with novel pseudowords rather than with trained real words.
supplementary_figures.primary_limitation: Three categories have n <= 7 and are descriptive only.
